Real-Time Compressive Object Tracking.
We propose a simple yet efficient tracking algorithm with data-independent random projections that preserve structure of the image space of objects.

(1) we propose a novel compressive tracking framework that is based on a nonadaptive random projection matrix, which can be efficiently computed and stored; (2) the appearance model is based on a sparse representation of the image feature subspace; and (3) the tracking task is formulated and solved as a binary classification problem in a compressed domain.
